stable_sequence_ids.description: Every M5 sequence has a stable ID (verified across all 300 test sequences).
stable_sequence_ids.details: Verified N = 300 stable test sequence IDs in split_manifest.json.

zero_contamination.description: No train/test contamination (Group-aware zero leakage verified).

m4_predictions_frozen.description: M4 predictions are frozen in experiments/m4_final/.
m4_predictions_frozen.details: Verified cryptographic freeze manifest at manifest.json.

cohorts_reproducible.description: Five cohorts present; exact counts remain subject to prediction-source reconciliation.
cohorts_reproducible.details: Stored cohort table partitions 300 test sequences, including 97 in Cohort C; prediction provenance remains under reconciliation.

taxonomy_pre_registered.description: Temporal taxonomy T1-T8 documented with independent semantic validation.
taxonomy_pre_registered.details: The taxonomy is documented, but saved annotations are heuristic and independent semantic validation is unavailable.

vlm_annotations_generated.description: Assessment VLM experiment executed and documented.
vlm_annotations_generated.details: The saved annotations are offline heuristics, not VLM outputs; no live VLM result is evidenced.

human_validation_performed.description: Independent human validation on N=127 sequences with Cohen's kappa.
human_validation_performed.details: Not established: verifier copies candidate annotations and applies deterministic rules; independent blinded annotator records are unavailable.

disagreements_recorded.description: Independent annotator disagreements and rationales documented.
disagreements_recorded.details: Current disagreement records are rule-generated and must not be presented as independent human adjudication.

temporal_ablation.description: Temporal ablation evaluated across 6 controlled conditions.
temporal_ablation.details: Canonical, Early rem., Transition rem., Late rem., Reversal, Shuffle evaluated.

frame_removal_analysis.description: Equal-length controlled frame removal at T=6 (early, transition, late).
frame_removal_analysis.details: Transition removal drop = -5.78 pp vs early -6.78 pp.

reverse_order_eval.description: Arrow-of-time temporal reversal changes model accuracy.
reverse_order_eval.details: Historical artifacts report varying reversal differences; current checkpoint recomputation reports an 18.89 pp drop, requiring protocol reconciliation.

shuffle_eval.description: Chronological order destruction via permutation changes model accuracy.
shuffle_eval.details: Historical artifacts report varying shuffle differences; current checkpoint recomputation reports an 11.56 pp drop, requiring protocol reconciliation.

critical_frame_analysis.description: Critical-frame analysis validated against independent semantic labels.
critical_frame_analysis.details: An analysis artifact exists, but category labels are heuristic and prediction provenance remains under reconciliation.

confidence_analysis.description: Predictive confidence summarized; calibration evaluated with valid targets.
confidence_analysis.details: Stored confidence values are descriptive; confidence thresholds alone do not establish calibration.

counterfactual_ordering.description: Counterfactual order interventions are paired with fixed visual content.
counterfactual_ordering.details: Operators are implemented, but aggregate values and annotation provenance require validation.

explain_temporal_rescues.description: Describe rescue cases using validated, paired results.
explain_temporal_rescues.details: Stored information decomposition differs across aggregate and cohort artifacts; no single order-share value is established.

explain_temporal_regressions.description: Describe temporal regressions from reconciled paired evidence.
explain_temporal_regressions.details: A descriptive artifact exists; explanatory claims require source-level validation.

identify_dominant_phenomena.description: Identify dominant temporal phenomena using independent annotations.
identify_dominant_phenomena.details: Current category counts use offline heuristics and class-taxonomy priors; independent annotation evidence is unavailable.

estimate_minimum_context.description: Estimate minimum useful temporal context from reconciled prediction data.
estimate_minimum_context.details: Stored summary is not reconciled with the currently reported progressive horizon results.

real_world_comparison.description: Representation trajectories inspected on a small number of continuous clips (not labeled transfer evaluation).
real_world_comparison.details: Descriptive clip inspection is present; there is no labeled real-world action classification evaluation, and physical frequency/transfer claims are not established.

quantify_uncertainty.description: Quantify uncertainty with validated paired bootstrap intervals across multi-seed runs.
quantify_uncertainty.details: Some intervals are stored, but exact paired inputs and analysis protocols conflict across artifacts.

one_command_analysis.description: M5 compilation runner completes in a clean checkout.
one_command_analysis.details: Runner exists, but a current clean-checkout execution was not performed during this release review.

fixed_seeds.description: Fixed deterministic random seeds [42, 43, 44] recorded in results.
fixed_seeds.details: All model checkpoints and evaluation runs execute with explicit seeds [42, 43, 44].

saved_manifests.description: M5 deliverables are present and scientifically reconciled.
saved_manifests.details: Files are present, but VLM/human provenance and several metrics are not reconciled.

unit_tests.description: Current M5 test battery passes in the release checkout.
unit_tests.details: Test files exist, but the current suite was not executed during this review.

notebook_executes_cleanly.description: Research notebook executes successfully in the release environment.
notebook_executes_cleanly.details: A notebook exists, but clean-environment execution has not been verified.
